name: mlr-guard
description: Claims-grounded content generation on the Cloudflare edge. An LLM may only assemble copy from pre-approved claims, every sentence carries its claim ID and reference anchor, and nothing reaches published without an authenticated human approval.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute mlr_guard --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute mlr_guard --local --file=./migrations/0002_seed.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute mlr_guard --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute mlr_guard --remote --file=./migrations/0002_seed.sql
